newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results May 19-23.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results May 19-23.

text.p: company results for the week of May 19-23:
NOTES - Profit figures exclude extraordinary items and are in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
They are stated before deduction of preference dividends where applicable.
The comparative figure for Nedlloyd includes a 30 million guilder book profit on the sale of ships.
The KLM forecast does not include an extraordinary charge arising from provisions for the Focus 2000 programme, estimated by analysts at some 150-200 million guilders.

FORECASTS CONTRIBUTED BY: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, Delta Lloyd Bank, Generale Bank, NIB Securities, ING Barings, Kempen & Co, Labouchere, Van Lanschot, MeesPierson, Rabo Securities, SNS Securities, Wesselius.
